mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in FEDFUNDS above the prior 10-month average predicts a near-term positive S&P 500 20-day forward return as investors anticipate accommodative policy sustaining equity valuations.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS crosses above its 10-month moving average
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative or flat despite FEDFUNDS above threshold, and 10-day volatility is not elevated.

mechanism_narrative: Rising monthly PAYEMS accompanied by UNRATE below 7% suggests weak labor market strength, which suppresses wage growth and dampens equity risk premia, leading to negative S&P 500 60-day forward returns.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive or flat, or PAYEMS growth is not statistically different from prior month.

mechanism_narrative: A consecutive monthly rise in HOUST and RSAFS above their 5-period moving averages signals strengthening business demand, which elevates earnings expectations and drives positive S&P 500 20-day returns.
candidate_trigger: HOUST and RSAFS both above 5-period moving averages for two consecutive months
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative despite persistent demand indicators, or the pattern fails to repeat over 6 months.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp decline in INDPRO below the 50th percentile of the past 12 months indicates contracting business capacity, which reduces growth expectations and predicts negative S&P 500 5-day forward returns.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are not statistically significant from zero, or INDPRO recovers above median within 2 months.

mechanism_narrative: When CPIAUCSL unexpectedly exceeds the prior quarter by more than 0.5%, it signals persistent inflation pressure and a higher probability of restrictive policy, resulting in negative S&P 500 20-day returns.
candidate_trigger: CPIAUCSL quarterly growth > 0.5 percentage points surprise
failure_condition: 20-day returns are positive or CPIAUCSL does not sustain surprise inflation for 3 consecutive quarters.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in UNRATE below 6% over 3 months suggests tighter labor market conditions, reducing equity risk premium and predicting negative S&P 500 60-day returns.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE falls continuously for 3 consecutive months below 6%
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive or UNRATE does not decline as predicted for 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous monthly increases in GDPC1 and PAYEMS above their 4-week averages indicate robust consumer and employment demand, which are associated with positive S&P 500 20-day forward returns.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 and PAYEMS both above 4-week moving averages
failure_condition: 20-day returns are flat or negative despite both proxies rising above thresholds.

mechanism_narrative: When INDPRO remains below its 5-year median for two consecutive months, it reflects structural supply-side constraints that suppress growth and predict negative S&P 500 60-day forward returns.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive or INDPRO crosses above median within 2 months.
